description: Bounded publication case for the current-source-certified Bajaj My Health Care cataract coverage limit for Sum Insured up to INR 10 lakh.

decision_reasons: The bounded governed rule certification passes with all required coverage-limit semantic components satisfied.
All published evidence is anchored to the reviewed current Bajaj My Health Care policy wording SHA-256 05dc291324340d5293f9f5f430f44b14e3da34052d6357455714af2dfa499158.

The publication is limited to cataract surgery for Sum Insured up to INR 10 lakh and preserves the unresolved schedule-selected waiting-period duration and separate SI above INR 10 lakh branch as limitations.

authoritative_publication.publication_authority: Phase 2 governed authoritative bounded-rule publication authority

guardrails: This case publishes only the bounded cataract coverage-limit rule for Sum Insured up to INR 10 lakh from the current 05dc29132434 source.
It preserves 20% of Sum Insured, maximum INR 1 lakh, per eye as one composed limit and does not flatten the rule to a single scalar amount.
It does not resolve or publish the waiting-period duration referenced through the Policy Schedule.
It does not resolve, reinterpret, or publish the separate SI above INR 10 lakh 'Actual' branch.
It does not publish Family Visit or any other Bajaj benefit limit.
It does not establish product-wide governed readiness or advisor/comparison readiness.
It does not guarantee claim admissibility or payment; all applicable policy terms remain controlling.
No product-specific production reasoning code is authorized by this case.
